settings.title: Settings
settings.uiKitDescription: Design system showcase: all components and states on one screen.
settings.profileDescription: Deletes profile and restarts onboarding. Coins, savings jar, and period history will be permanently lost.

demoMode.title: Demo mode
demoMode.desc1: Five consecutive periods without waiting for real time. Direction actuals are currently zero — wallet and tasks will appear later.
demoMode.desc2: Child profile is preserved: it waits during the demo and is restored completely.
demoMode.confirmDesc: The game will switch to the test profile. Child progress will be saved and restored when demo mode is turned off.

profileRestart.modalDescWithName: Profile “{{playerName}}” will be deleted from the device: coins, savings jar, and period history ({{finishedPeriods}}) will be lost.
profileRestart.modalDescWithoutName: Profile will be deleted from the device: coins, savings jar, and period history will be lost.
profileRestart.modalWarning: It cannot be restored — onboarding will start from scratch.

home.title: Paw
home.roomComingSoon: Pet room will appear in the first wave
home.planBannerBody: Decide where the coins go first — then you can spend.

goal.noneHint: Open the savings jar and pick what to save for

task.title: Task
task.comingSoon: Tasks will show up here very soon

soon.shopText: The shop will open here: food, warmth and everything a home needs.
soon.toysText: Toys and decorations for the room will arrive here.
soon.fridgeText: You will be able to feed the pet here.
soon.stoveText: You will be able to cook here.

play.a11y: You can stroke, tap and lift
play.hint: Swipe to stroke. Tap to boop. Hold and pull up to lift

petCreate.title: Who is in the box
petCreate.subtitle: Choose who you take home and come up with a name
petCreate.nameHint: Pick any name — you can change it later

onboarding.title: What is happening here
body: You are getting to know the game: boop the pet, sort into boxes, scratch a coin ticket, and pick how I look.
Three boxes: Needs — essentials, Wants — nice things, Savings — for a goal.
You cannot fail. Any step can be retried, nothing will be lost.

home.title: Main Screen
body: Here you see the pet, coins, savings jar, and what the pet is currently doing.
Coins come from chores and tasks. Each income shows where it came from.
Tap «?» on any screen — I will tell you what to do there.

uiKit.title: Developer Screen
body: This is a component showcase: buttons, cards, meters, and sheets in all states.
It helps the team test the UI, and is not part of the game storyline.

ui-kit.title: Developer Screen
body: This is a component showcase: buttons, cards, meters, and sheets in all states.
It helps the team test the UI, and is not part of the game storyline.

onboarding.starterCoinsCaption: Coins always show where they came from. Later, chores will bring more.
onboarding.privacyNote: The game stays on this device — it sends nothing anywhere.
onboarding.nameHintEmpty: Type any name — only you will see it
onboarding.nameHintFilled: You can change the name later in the parents section
onboarding.remainderHint: Tap a box — a coin jumps in. You may keep some for yourself.

greeting.title: Meet me!
greeting.line: Boop my nose — then we'll look at three magic boxes. If anything is unclear, tap «?» above.

sorting.title: Three boxes
sorting.line: Drag the card into a box. If you miss, I will simply say where it belongs. You cannot fail!

coins.title: Secret ticket
coins.line: Rub the grey layer with your finger, like a lottery ticket — and see your first coins.

plan.title: Place the coins
plan.line: Put coins into the boxes. You may keep some — you'll do the same at the start of every period.

pet.title: How will I look?
pet.line: Pick who I am: cat, dog or capybara — and a coat colour. Names come next!

name.title: Sign by the door
name.line: Type your player name — I will hang a sign over the door.

bread.title: Bread and milk
bread.explanation: Food is a Need: you cannot get through the period without it.

heating.title: Heating at home
heating.explanation: Heating is paid every period, otherwise it gets chilly. That's a Need.

toy-car.title: Toy car
toy-car.explanation: A toy car is a Want: it's fun, but you can live without it.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.explanation: Stickers are a Want: you can buy them in the next period.

scooter.title: Saving for a scooter
scooter.explanation: Not enough to buy a scooter right away, so we put it in Savings.

rainy-day.title: Saving for a rainy day
rainy-day.explanation: Savings help when something breaks. That's also Savings.

onboarding.scratchHint: Scratch off the grey layer — like a lottery ticket.
onboarding.boopA11y: Boop the pet on the nose
onboarding.trayEmpty: All coins are in the boxes
onboarding.petPreviewA11y: This is how the pet will look

budgetPlan.title: Budget plan
budgetPlan.remainderHint: You do not have to allocate every coin — the remainder carries into the next period.
budgetPlan.needsZeroBody: There will be nothing to buy food and heating with. Confirm the plan anyway?
